Note. Values are effect estimates with 95% CIs. The primary cellular analysis includes 798,100 nuclei from 75 specimens and 23 patients. In the primary V2/V3 decomposition, the within-cell-type program-score component exceeded the fine-cell-type composition component in all eight lineage-program comparisons. V4 decomposition is reported for completeness; its myeloid total effect was near zero.

Note. Values are V1-adjusted effect estimates with percentile 95% CIs from 5,000 patient-cluster bootstrap replicates in which the V1 model was refit within each replicate. The direction of the total effect was preserved in all eight lineage-program comparisons, and the within-cell-type component remained larger in absolute magnitude than the fine-cell-type composition component in all eight. A uniform patient-only random-intercept analysis preserved the same ordering.
